steps.reply: **What it does:** cctrace is an HTTP traffic tracer for agent CLIs (Claude Code, codex, grok, kimi, opencode) — it captures the full wire exchange via a TLS-intercepting proxy and serves a live web UI (requests, sessions, context, cost) plus trace-management commands over the saved `.jsonl`. **Which hosts get decrypted:** `src/certs.ts` — `buildInterceptSet()` (src/certs.ts:240) assembles the include-list from the client plugin's `firstPartyHosts`/category pins/`providerHosts`/`configHosts`, base-url env hosts, and `--intercept-host` extras; `src/mitm.ts` then decides at CONNECT time, and everything outside that set is an opaque byte-counted tunnel.
